rfqLines.formIntro: Price the lines you can supply. Leave a line empty to skip it, or mark it as can't supply. The buyer can award lines to different suppliers, so a partial quote is fine.
rfqLines.skipHint: Leave empty to skip this line.
rfqLines.summaryHint: The final total, with GST per line, is calculated when you send.
rfqLines.errPrice: Enter a valid price for line {n}.
